body: Surveillance was everywhere in the affluent Chicago area where FBG Duck's murder took place in 2020. The convicted killers likely thought they were going to get away with the crime despite it being in broad daylight. However, in 2024, a jury convicted six members or associates of violent street gang O-Block on racketeering offenses that included the murder of FBG Duck. Hit link in bio to watch the Take It to Trial podcast. Allegations are not findings of guilt.
